children: Poland's central bank said on Friday that price stability will remain the primary objective of monetary policy in 2027, while policy will also support sustainable economic growth and financial stability.
The bank kept its medium-term inflation target at 2.5% with a tolerance band of plus or minus 1 percentage point, it said in a statement.
